nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Glow Continuous Spray SPF30

avis.texte: I have purchased before and like this product. Unfortunately, upon using this one I realized the sprayer was broken and only sprays in a weak stream versus a spray.

The sunscreen itself is fine but the bottle is hard to twist between locked and unlocked. I must have accidentally jammed mine because it also just... doesn't spray anymore...so I might return this if I can. This was also my first continuous spray bottle and I'm not a fan of that either, would rather just spritz it.
love the glow that this gives my mature skin. I order one every year!
No residue, adds shine, kinda greasy feel not dry. Great for my tattoos
Really like this SPF Spray. It's easy to apply and goes on smoothly. I only use it on my body. Never tried on my face as I usually use the lotion for my face.
I love the make it glow sunscreen. Just spray it on and rub it in. No mess or white cast. Definitely a must have for summer vacation at the beach.
I looove the sunscreen spray!!! Ive been using the cream for a few years, but this spray is the thing!!!! It's easy to apply and because I have a sun allergy, I can do all of me quickly!!!
The ease of this spray has made it my go-to travel sunscreen. It's easy to spray it on arms and use hands to apply it to face. It dries quickly and I haven't noticed it staining any of my clothing.
Love this! Doesn't leave a white cast, not sticky and the lock top actually stays shut when it's not being used.
Great product. It sprays on easy and isn't greasy. I'm in the pool on a daily basis, so this helps protect my skin.

avis.titre: it's exactly what it says it is
avis.texte: this stuff is great. absorbs immediately. no white cast, no scent (despite the claims of alcohol scent) so it doesn't interfere with perfume. doesn't gunk up jewelry either. love it.
My family have used every BGS for years and will continue to use as long as it's available. Great protection for our skin.
Used for 2 weeks in the hot, strong Caribbean sun! Great coverage and many hours protection.
Works great and I'm not allergic to this kind. Love this product! I don't look ashy after putting it on. Thank you!
I really like this product. Easy to apply. Gave a wonderful glow to the skin when in the sun.
We love this stuff. Please do not change the formula. Works so great for my skin
Great product! Keep up the good work! Black Girl majic rules!!
This sunscreen makes your skin feel so soft and hydrated, I love the ingredients put into this product and yes, it does. Keep the sun away.
Love the way it moisturizes your skin and does not lave the white residue
Used multiple products during a cruise through the Caribbean. No burns, golden glowy tan. Amazing. Will purchase again.
I work with kids outside all day and its so light weight for both me and the kids. And it doesn't even make me feel oily either.
sensitive skin, prone to break outs with lots of new products. this sunscreen was great!

avis.titre: 1st SPF I've ever purchased and I love it.
avis.texte: It does the work! No skin burning, no irritation, no strong scent. My husband and my son both work outdoors for a good portion of their jobs and they have no complaints!
Absolutely love this sunscreen! Because this sunscreen was made with my skin in mind actually encouraged me to wear sunscreen. It doesn't leave white residue. Skins look fresh and glowy.

Im reading a lot of reviews and honestly yall dont know how to use sunscreen. Why are you spraying it directly on your face and over your makeup. If you are using it on your face spray some in your hands and pat it of your face and also do a patch test when trying new products. Everyone skin is different.
We love this product, the only thing is the sprayer seems to clog up and doesn't come out as it should..
It leaves my skin with the right amount of shine and no white residue. Very smooth
It applies evenly and has no white cast. I did run out quick though, but I might just be heavy handed

avis.titre: Black Girl Make It Glow SPF 30 Spray Sunscreen
avis.texte: Too greasy for me. The spray is a heavier feel and stings a little as well. I use the matte in the tube which I just love. I work outside and I thought it would be easier to spray then too kept touching my face by reapplying the gel every few hours.

avis.titre: Spray works great for my skin!
avis.texte: I always used the lotion version of this sunscreen, but I decided to give the continuous spray version. Good thing I did because this works better than the lotion. Less greasy and more coverage. Will be buying this one from now on!

First the size: it's great for travelling. it's small enough to fit in a carryon which is great. Price: very high, comparatively for what you're getting. functionality: the spray function didn't work the greatest for me and unfortunately wasn't a great experience. It comes out too watery and got all over my clothes instead of an even fine spray that can be gently massaged into the skin, if it needs massaging at all. instead it came out like a squirt of very awkward and watery lotion. smell: it's got a hint of alcohol to it which isn't the greatest. Overall: I use BGS lipgloss and facial SPF which are absolutely great but will be continuing to use my usual spf body spray until Black Girl Sunscreen sorts this out which i have NO doubt they'll do. cheers.
I will say this moisturizer is immediate effect,after using it I was glowing like a Hollywood star,will definitely buy a. I give it five stars
I LOVEEE this sunscreen! I used to use the lotion version but the spray works all over your skin.
Its easy to apply. It leaves no residue and has me glowing. I would highly recommend it and they have great customer service.

avis.titre: Makes a huge difference in oily skin
avis.texte: I bought this just to use to go to the beach, but the next morning my skin looked so good. I started using it daily as part of my morning routine and I get compliments all the time about my skin. I saw someone didn't like that you couldn't spray directly to the face but honestly as an oily skin girl, it really should be rubbed into the skin, otherwise it just sits on top very dewy. I am at work at 7 and normally oily by 1 but since using this, I have a nice glow but significantly less oily than I am bare faced. I also don't wear makeup to work, drink lots of water, and barely get 6 hours sleep. So I promise you it really is the sunscreen because my habits have gotten worst but my face is still improving from being acne prone and very sensitive. They make a version specifically for face I want to try.

Love this product, i spray a little in my hand and rub into my face, neck, chest and arms for an amazing glow. My coworker kept saying this is something extremely beautiful about your skin…had to share my secret lol

I began ordering BGS for vacationing in the islands and for my daughter who is a true Piscean/Water lover. Approaching menopause, I started taking an oral Rx for hormonal acne about 2ys ago- until recently. I had lapsed in my acne med refills and oddly enough, I learned my daughter was wearing BGS30 and GLOWING on a daily basis. I tried it (off vacation) and my skin has been GORGEOUS ever since. Guess what? No Rx in almost 45 days now. Thank you!!!
You will only be able to spray your full body two times with this sunscreen. Too expensive for the size.

avis.titre: Sunscreen that doesn't dry out your skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen is light and easy to put on. It moisturizes your skin and doesn't cake up after applying it.

Was upset that I had to share this treasure with family members that forgot their sunscreen for our yacht cruise. Single can is not for sharing, my can emptied fast! This stuff is liquid gold! So easy to apply and last all day even in salt water. Next time I will purchase a few cans.

avis.titre: Not for spraying directly on face
avis.texte: I think it's important to mention that reading directions before using a product is very important. Unfortunately that's not what I did. I sprayed this directly on my face and it clearly states in a direction to spray in your hands and then apply to your face which I believe defeats the purpose as to why I bought this product because I want it that I can spray on my face without disrupting my make up if that's what you're looking for this is not it but I do believe this is a great product to have to spray on your neck and body.

I live the spray in because it goes a long way and you can rub it in and get other areas covered. I use it on my body only. This is my first time and it seems there is not much spray in the bottle. Be mindful because it ran out so quick it seemed like I had a used bottle, but overall I love the feel. It's easy to rub in.
My skin glowing, every day I'm sunkissed, it's a lil inconvenient to put on cause I gotta spray it in my hand to apply but its so good
I loved the product. It didn't leave a residue. I would like a larger size so it could last longer.
Great product gives a nice shine but not a greasy look for feel
Love that this is an easy spray. I use on my body before going outside. No white caste not greasy.

This was a good spf for the body! Its just not enough product. I only used this maybe 7 or 8 times and the product was gone.. and I know I didnt spray too much. I don't this the price is worth the product amount.

avis.titre: I needed this in my life!
avis.texte: I love it! There is no white residue. It actually gives me the dewy glow that I love. I cannot believe how excited I am to put on sunscreen protection every day.

I love to sunscreen especially for going out because the sheen looks so nice on brown skin. It's also easy to apply. I love the way sunscreen smells in general, so it didn't bother me at all. Wish the bottle was a little larger though.
it doesn't leave that white residue/cast on my skin. it dries fairly quick and doesn't have the sunscreen smell. my co workers. i wish more sunscreeen was made like this.
This is a great product. I especially love that it leaves a sheen on my skin. I would highly recommend this product.
Great product! It does not leave a white cast/residue and it is fragrance free. It provides amazing coverage while giving your skin an amazing glow.
Size is too small. I was traveling with my family. I felt confident about the protection. it's smell great.
I love this product. I feel great while wearing it. It does not have a medicinal scent and it feels cool while being sprayed on to my skin. No regrets so far.

avis.titre: A bit oily around the eyes but otherwise, it's perfect!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a few weeks now. I'm really enjoying it except I do get a bit oily from it and the excess oil builds up mostly around my eyelids. A few swipes with a paper towel helps but I think I'll switch to the lotion for my face. Patiently waiting for an On-the-Go stick version! Please! I love the size of this spray as it fits conveniently into my bags.

Got this in a recent sample bag. Was happy to try the brand but it was a horrible first impression. Smells like alcohol. Doesnt spray on evenly even after shaking and spraying. I felt like i got more alcohol than actual sunscreen. The nozzle is a mess after using. It is greasy.
Very convenient spray bottle. Works wonderfully! I just wish it came in a bigger size.

I domt have sensitive akin but this stuff gave me the worst rash ever. I bought it for a trip and didnt use it, but when i got home i tested it out on one arm and the rash moved up all the way to my face. Retuned it so fast.
I love this product. Not too heavy and applied every two hours and works well
heard good things about the brand and i dont have senstive skin but i tested it out just on my arm and i broke me out in hives and a whole rash on my face. Stick to regular cream sunscreen
I was extremely excited to use this product. However I was very disappointed in the size. The entire bottle was empty after using for 3 of a 6 day Caribbean trip.

it defintiely gives you a glow and it looks great! but it doesnt have that much product in it. i used the entire can with 1 trip to the beach on my own….i swear i didnt use that much but its a small can lol

I wanted to love this spray, but it's very very very greasy. Even after rubbing it in, it felt like it was just sitting on top of my skin like oil. It did give me a nice glow though. It just felt like i was covered in oil.
I am pleased with the product as it offers great coverage and no ashen residue

avis.titre: Absolute genius idea to have as a spray
avis.texte: When i first started using BGS years ago, I fell in love with the application on my skin. I would use it frequently (as I should be) and would run out. Long story short, I was hoping there was a sunscreen spray option and boy I was excited when I saw it in stock! This spray makes it so much easier for me when I am getting ready for outside antics. Run, don't walk and get in tuned.

avis.titre: Easy to use, quick to finish
avis.texte: The smell initially is kind of aerosolic for obvious reasons, but it didn't seem to linger on the skin long. My only gripe is that the small size only lasted me about a month and I was hoping it would last longer especially for the price. So I think I might pick the kid's spray sunscreen from now on to get more band for my buck.
I love this sunscreen! It gives my skin a beautiful glow and smells great!

So grateful to have a sunscreen designed just for my skin! It's thick but I like & smooths on easily without leaving white residue after applying. Trying to get better with applying every two hours but I would definitely recommend to my sisters of color! Thank you makers of black girl sun screen !!!

very good size. The residue is light and dries fast; it does make me a lil greasy so i have to dab my face after application so i dont llook like im sweating or shiny. and I personally like the sunscreen pool smell; its not overpowering just a nice nostalgic scent. I use this one for on the go places like hiking or disneyland mainly for reapplication every 2 hours.

avis.titre: Amazing Sunscreen Glow! Top 5 Sunscreen Products
avis.texte: Thank you for giving me the opportunity to write this review.

avis.titre: Beautiful glow and Protects from the Sun
avis.texte: Easy to use spray, does a great job protecting your skin from the sun and gives you gorgeous glow.

Easy to use and it spreads very well. The glow is instantaneous and last for a long time. I'm unsure if I used too much, but after just a 5 day trip to Miami it seems almost empty. I use the cream in my daily body routine but wanted something easy for the beach. I'd definitely purchase again and highly recommend it to others.
This makes my skin glow very light spray will be ordering again.

Purchased primarily as a body sunscreen and used another type for my face. Im a darker skin mexican woman that tends to find most sunscreens hard to blend bevause of the white cast it leaves or some can have too rosey undertones geared for fair skin. This sprayed i used on my legs, arms, chest, hands and feet. I used once on my face but personally dont like spraying my face due to the potential inhalation and stinging of the eyes so use a sunscreen stick. I love how it made my skin glow without leaving a greasy residue or fear itll transfer on my clothes. Also because i sprayed it all over, I never felt sticky or no skin stinging.
The size was perfect for my hiking pouch but I do wish there was a full-size option available as I ran out after 2 days of using this.

avis.titre: Not the best in the market
avis.texte: Not the best sun screen to reapply to the face because it will burn your eyes even if you have them closed. I like the dewy and glow it gave me but i have to spray on my hand and then apply it that way for it to work for me. I think it might be better just for body use!
I love the sunscreen. It really is Black Girl Magic. Love the Glow. Will need to re-order soon.
I love the way it makes my skin glow. I've got 1 for everyday wear the other can in my beach bag. Stock up during a sale. You'll be happy you did!

avis.titre: It's for your body… works great.
avis.texte: I love this SpF. I can tell that most of the bad reviews are people applying this to their face when it is meant for the body…

Love black girl sunscreen. I use it daily. I was looking for a spray to be able to reapply spf throughout the day so I purchased this. I read the directions, sprayed onto my hand and applied. I was immediately hit with the smell of alcohol & my face started burning. Luckily I was home and was able to wash it off. Definitely do not recommend!
I used it for my trip and it was great. The size was perfect for travel.
Love this product no white residue left and there is no over bearing smell, and it protest your skin from the sun

The spray is not fine enough to spray on your face without rubbing it in. Also has a very strong alcohol scent. If you have sensitive skin, do not buy! It gave me small little bumps all over my face that I'm still recovering from 4 days later
I love everything about the spray and formula. I only wish that it came with 50 SPF
I do not like the nozzle. It comes out too hard but I love black girl sunscreen

This is the best. When they Say GLOW, Yes you will have that glow. Someone saw me today and said you look good oh my goodness you got a glow. I said a glow? They said yes. I was saying I have a secret weapon. It was that sun screen. I will always have this in my arsenal. (LOL).
Works great on my skin as I was recently diagnosed with severe eczema. Really love this product!

I recently used this during my vacation to the Bahamas. I love the spray on application and it rubs in very well and gives a nice glow. The only downside is the can lasted just about for the week of vacation. Next time I'll be sure to pack 2 or also a tube of the cream sunscreen.
Stay away from this product if you have sensitive skin. I used this and it almost ruined my trip. I broke out in a rash wherever this product touched my skin. I trashed it immediately.
The moment I sprayed the can, it felt like I was literally maced! It burned so bad, and smelled awful. Please just stick with the regular sunscreen cream!

avis.titre: It is the most awful sunscreen I have ever used
avis.texte: This sunscreen burned my face immediately upon contact with my skin. It smells awful even though it says it's fragrance free. Do not buy this product.
feels good on my skin and definitely no white cast, it creates a nice glow

This product I recommend !! Bought it for a Cancun trip and me and my boys sprayed it and definitely had us looking glowy in the sun and at pool parties. There is protection which i do like and also is not sticky or have any fragrance like other sunscreen brands.

This is the sunscreen I've been waiting for for all of my beach loving life! I've enjoyed the sunscreen in the tube , but I love a spray so have really appreciated both the convenience and effectiveness of make it glow.
